Next.js club management system for TJ Sokol Svinov (Czech handball club). Stack: Next.js 16 App Router · TypeScript strict · Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth) · TanStack Query v5 · HeroUI v2 · Tailwind CSS v4 · Vitest. UI language is **Czech** — all user-facing strings must be in Czech.

Available slash-command skills in `.claude/skills/` (use **without being asked** when the situation matches):  
`/new-entity` — whenever user asks to add a new database table, data model, or CRUD feature. Do not scaffold files manually; invoke this skill.  
`/db-sync` — after any DB migration is applied or when TypeScript types are out of sync with the database schema.  
`/new-migration` — whenever a new table, column, function, view, or RLS policy needs to be created in the database.  
`/generate-barrels` — after adding, renaming, or removing any hook, component, type, or enum file. Run before committing.  
`/review-pr` — when user asks for a code review / PR review / “check my changes”.

Entity layout (repeat per entity):  
`src/types/entities/{camelCase}/schema/{camelCase}Schema.ts` (AUTO-GENERATED, do not edit manually)  
`data/{camelCase}.ts` domain types extending schema  
`src/queries/{pluralCamel}/constants.ts` (DB_TABLE + ENTITY), `queries.ts` (read funcs, `QueryContext` pattern), `mutations.ts` (write funcs, `QueryContext` pattern), `index.ts` barrel  
`src/hooks/entities/{kebab-case}/data/useFetch{Entity}s.ts` factory, `state/use{Entity}.ts` createCRUDHook factory  
`src/lib/translations/{pluralCamel}.ts` Czech strings

Context/client rules:  
Client component/browser: `supabaseBrowserClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/client`  
Server component: `supabaseServerClient()` from `@/utils/supabase/server`  
API route (authenticated): `withAuth(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`  
API route (admin only): `withAdminAuth(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`  
API route (public): `withPublicAccess(handler)` from `@/utils/supabase/apiHelpers`  
Coach role checks in API routes: `hasCoachRole()` / `isAdmin()` / `checkCoachCardAccess()` from `@/utils/supabase/coachAuth` — these are **auth helpers, not clients**  
Never import a server client in a client component or vice versa. Prefer `apiHelpers` wrappers over calling `supabaseServerClient()` directly in API routes.

Query/mutation functions: In `src/queries/`, every function signature is `fn(ctx: QueryContext, ...)` and uses `ctx.supabase`. Never call the Supabase client directly inside query files.

Regenerate-only files (auto-generated, never edit manually):  
`src/hooks/index.ts`, `src/types/index.ts`, `src/components/index.ts`

Manual files (always update by hand):  
`src/lib/api-routes.ts`, `src/lib/translations/index.ts`

Component barrel generator opt-out:  
File-level: add `// <REDACTED_USER>` on any of the first 5 lines of a `.ts`/`.tsx` file.  
Folder-level: drop an empty `.barrel-ignore` inside directory (e.g. `SomeComponent/utils/.barrel-ignore`). Generator logs `⏭️  Skipping ...` for excluded paths.

Layout components rule: Use provided components instead of raw Tailwind flex/grid classes; they enforce consistent spacing/responsive breakpoints. Tailwind CSS does not support dynamic class construction (e.g. `` `flex-${direction}` ``). Layout components must use static lookup maps.

Grid usage (equal/unequal columns):  
`src/components/ui/Grid/Grid.tsx`, `src/components/ui/Grid/components/GridItem.tsx`  
`Grid columns` type `1-6` default `3`; `Grid gap` `'sm'|'md'|'lg'|'xl'` default
